text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for customer NebulaWorks (dedicated) slice-7: rwinf-2.3.1 -> rwinf-2.4.0-quant at 2025-11-05T03:00Z. Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full within 2h change window. Release notes: kernel selection improvements, kv-cache stability fix, batcher tuning. ops: please ack and confirm smoke run location.

sara: Ack. Who's owning canary watch? :eyes:

kevin: I can. Primary checks: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token-cost delta. Suggest rollback if p95 > +35% OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained over 10m.

maria: For Dedicated we need tenant pinning: nebulaworks-prod -> rwinf-2.4.0-quant. Confirm pin will be applied before ramp to 50%.

jamal: Note for Private customers: confirm KMS rotation window. NebulaWorks uses customer KMS key "nw-prod-kms" — want security to sign off that no rotation overlaps the change window.

ops-qa: Smoke plan uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/nebulaworks/smoke/2025-11-05. Tests: basic generate, embeddings, kv-cache warmup, token cost sanity checks. Will run 2x pre-flight.

ryan: Also add fallback routing: pin rwinf-2.3.1-fallback in route policy so we can divert quickly if a capacity or kernel regression shows up.

sara: Add these flags to deploybot schedule command:
```
deploybot schedule --tenant nebulaworks --slice 7 --version rwinf-2.4.0-quant --canary 10/15m --ramp 50/30m --full 2h --rollback "p95:+35%,5xx:0.5%/10m"
```

maria: +1. I'll take post-deploy smoke and draft release note. Jamal, can you confirm KMS window by EOD?

jamal: Confirmed with security — KMS maintenance window clear for the change window. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2483456920. 10% traffic routed to slice-7.

kevin: Early telemetry: p95 +12%, p50 +6%, 5xx 0.05%. No alerts.

ops-qa: First smoke run green at 5m. kv-cache warmup looked normal.

sara: Proceeding to 50% ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% executed at 2483456900. Traffic now 50% for 30m monitoring window.

kevin: After ramp: p95 +18%, 5xx 0.08%. Still below rollback thresholds. No action.

ryan: Routing policy pinned, and fallback variant staged. Ops runbook ready if we need immediate divert.

maria: Preliminary post-rollout: avg token latency improved ~8%, memory kernel selection seems stable, cost delta ~0%. Drafting release note to include quantization caveats.

sara: Great work. I'll leave the window open until final metrics at +2h then close. :thumbsup:

ops-qa: Final metrics snapshot saved: s3://redwood-ci/nebulaworks/postroll/2025-11-05/metrics.json

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 2483456945. No rollback triggered.

sara: Closing the change window. Thanks everyone.
